findings.explanation: The Opportunity query is inside the loop over accounts, so each account runs one query. A batch of more than 100 accounts exceeds the 100 SOQL query limit per transaction.
findings.fix: Query Opportunities once for all account IDs before the loop, group the amounts by AccountId in a map, then loop over the accounts and look up each total in the map.

findings.explanation: update acc runs once per account. More than 150 accounts exceed the 150 DML statement limit per transaction.
findings.fix: Add each account to a list inside the loop and run one update on the list after the loop.

findings.explanation: The class declaration has no sharing keyword, so the class does not enforce record sharing rules itself.
findings.fix: Declare the class as public with sharing class AccountService.

findings.explanation: The Opportunity query runs in system mode and ignores the running user's object and field permissions.
findings.fix: Add WITH USER_MODE to the query.

findings.explanation: getTopAccounts queries Account in system mode, so it returns fields the running user may not be allowed to see.
findings.fix: Add WITH USER_MODE before LIMIT, for example: ... ORDER BY AnnualRevenue DESC WITH USER_MODE LIMIT :howMany.

findings.explanation: System.debug is left in production code. It is harmless but adds log noise.

countOpenCases is called once per account inside the loop, and it runs a Case query (line 19) each time, so the query count grows with the number of accounts. The scanner did not flag this because the query is in a helper method.
findings.fix: Before the loop, run one aggregate query for all account IDs: SELECT AccountId, COUNT(Id) cnt FROM Case WHERE AccountId IN :accountIds AND IsClosed = false WITH USER_MODE GROUP BY AccountId. Put the counts in a map and check the map inside the loop.

findings.explanation: searchTerm is joined into the query string (lines 11-12) and passed to Database.query. A user can type a single quote and add their own conditions to the WHERE clause. WITH USER_MODE and with sharing still apply, so the risk is altered filtering and errors rather than a sharing bypass.
findings.fix: Use a static query with a bind variable: String pattern = '%' + searchTerm + '%'; then results = [SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Contact WHERE LastName LIKE :pattern WITH USER_MODE LIMIT 50];

findings.explanation: The QueryException is caught and the catch block is empty (line 16). Results stay null and the page shows nothing, with no message and no log.
findings.fix: Add a message to the page, for example ApexPages.addMessage(new ApexPages.Message(ApexPages.Severity.ERROR, 'Search failed. Try again.')), and log e.getMessage() if needed.

findings.explanation: Database.update(inv, false) runs once per invoice. More than 150 invoices exceed the DML statement limit per transaction.
findings.fix: Remove the update from the loop. Set the fields on each invoice, then call Database.update(invoices, false) once after the loop.

findings.explanation: The queue ID is hardcoded. The 00G prefix means a Group (queue) record. The ID exists only in one org, so the class breaks in sandboxes and after deployment to other orgs.
findings.fix: Look up the queue by DeveloperName, for example [SELECT Id FROM Group WHERE Type = 'Queue' AND DeveloperName = 'Finance' LIMIT 1], and cache the result in a variable.

findings.explanation: Only Trigger.new[0] is read. When 200 opportunities are saved together, the other 199 never get the record type.
findings.fix: Loop over every record: for (Opportunity opp : Trigger.new) { if (opp.Amount != null && opp.Amount > 500000) { opp.RecordTypeId = ...; } }

findings.explanation: The record type ID is hardcoded. Record type IDs differ between orgs, so this value is wrong in every org except the one it came from.
findings.fix: Get the ID by developer name: Schema.SObjectType.Opportunity.getRecordTypeInfosByDeveloperName().get('Partner').getRecordTypeId(). Confirm the developer name 'Partner' in the target org.

notes: InvoiceSyncService.cls: Database.update(inv, false) ignores the returned SaveResult list. Failed invoices are skipped without any record, and they stay Sync_Status__c = 'Queued'. No rule covers this. Check the results and log or report the failures.

InvoiceSyncService.cls: the query uses WITH USER_MODE, but the update does not. DML runs in system mode unless it uses 'as user' or AccessLevel.USER_MODE, so the update does not check the user's object or field permissions.
ContactSearchController.cls: % and _ in searchTerm are not escaped, so users can still widen the LIKE match after the bind-variable fix. Escape them if the search must match exact text.
OpportunityTrigger.trigger: the logic sits directly in the trigger body. A trigger handler class would make it easier to test and to extend.
AccountServiceTest.cls was scanned but not read. Test classes are not checked against the rules, and the scan found nothing.

CaseEscalationService.cls was read in full and has no scanner findings. The review finding above is the only issue. ContactTrigger.trigger and LeadConversionService.cls were read in full and have no findings.
